scene_zh: 一家上海外卖平台的月度数据（模拟）

views.subject: Food delivery orders
views.subtitle_en: Monthly orders for a Shanghai delivery platform.

examples.en: Orders bottomed out in February, at 7.6 million.
examples.zh: 单量在二月触底，为 760 万单。

features.note_zh: bottom out 是“触底”的口语短语；书面也可说 reach its lowest point。
features.interpret_zh: 二月低点很可能与春节有关，但图里没有日历信息，不能直接断言原因。

examples.en: Orders climbed steadily from 9.1 million in March to 11.8 million in June.
examples.zh: 单量从三月的 910 万单稳步升到六月的 1180 万单。

features.note_zh: climb 暗示连续、逐步上升；steadily 说节奏稳定。
features.interpret_zh: 连续三个月上升，但涨幅并不相同。

examples.en: Orders peaked in August at 14.1 million.
examples.zh: 单量在八月达到峰值 1410 万单。

features.note_zh: peak 作动词直接跟 at + 数值，不加 reached a peak at 的重复结构。
features.interpret_zh: 八月峰值是全年最高点，不代表长期趋势。

examples.en: Orders fell from 13.9 million in September to 10.8 million in October.
examples.zh: 单量从九月的 1390 万单跌到十月的 1080 万单。

features.note_zh: fall 是中性下降；如果幅度很大，可以用 drop sharply。
features.interpret_zh: 一个月少了约 22%，但图里没有解释原因。

examples.en: The decline reversed in December, when orders rose to 12.6 million.
examples.zh: 十二月走势反转，单量回升到 1260 万单。

features.note_zh: reverse 指方向反转；turning point 是名词，不要写成 turn point。
features.interpret_zh: 回升只出现一个月，还不能称为稳定趋势。

examples.en: Orders dipped slightly in November, from 10.8 to 10.5 million.
examples.zh: 十一月单量小幅下降，从 1080 万单到 1050 万单。

features.note_zh: dip 指短暂小幅下降；slightly 说幅度，不说明持续时间。
features.interpret_zh: 这个区间几乎持平，说“暴跌”会夸大。

views.overview_zh: 全年先低后高，八月见顶，秋季回落，十二月反弹。二月低点和八月高点最值得描述，但单月起伏不能直接归因于某个事件。

general.a2: Orders started low in February, went up through the summer, and peaked in August. After a drop in the fall, they rose again in December.
general.b1: Orders climbed from 7.6 million in February to a peak of 14.1 million in August, then fell to 10.8 million in October. A rebound in December brought them back to 12.6 million.
general.b2: Order volume followed a clear seasonal arc: a February trough, steady growth through the spring, and an August peak of 14.1 million. The autumn decline was steep, but December showed a partial recovery.

descriptions.ielts: The number of orders was lowest in February, at 7.6 million, and rose steadily to a peak of 14.1 million in August. It then declined to 10.8 million in October before recovering to 12.6 million in December.
descriptions.business: Demand peaked at 14.1 million orders in August and fell sharply into October, before a December rebound. The pattern points to a seasonal summer peak; capacity planning should protect the June–August window.

views.subject: Average order value

examples.en: Breakfast has the lowest average order value, at 22 yuan.
examples.zh: 早餐的客单价最低，为 22 元。

features.note_zh: the lowest + 名词 + at + 数值；low 形容水平，不形容数量。
features.interpret_zh: 低客单价不代表低利润，还要看成本。

examples.en: Afternoon tea averages 31 yuan, seven yuan below lunch.
examples.zh: 下午茶平均 31 元，比午餐低 7 元。

features.note_zh: below / above + 数值 直接说差距。
features.interpret_zh: 这是平均值比较，不说明每个订单的分布。

examples.en: Dinner ranks second, at 46 yuan per order.
examples.zh: 晚餐排第二，每单 46 元。

features.note_zh: rank second / come second；不要说 rank the second。
features.interpret_zh: 排名只看这里列出的五个餐段。

examples.en: Late-night orders are the highest, at 54 yuan.
examples.zh: 夜宵订单最高，为 54 元。

features.note_zh: the highest 后接名词时注意单复数：orders are the highest。
features.interpret_zh: 夜宵客单价最高，但单量可能远低于午晚餐。

views.overview_zh: 客单价从早餐到夜宵整体上升：早餐 22 元最低，夜宵 54 元最高。客单价高不等于总销售额高，还要看单量。

general.a2: Late-night orders cost the most, at 54 yuan. Breakfast is the cheapest, at 22 yuan. Lunch and dinner sit in between.
general.b1: Average order value rises from 22 yuan at breakfast to 54 yuan late at night. Dinner is second at 46 yuan, while afternoon tea is slightly cheaper than lunch.
general.b2: Average order value increases steadily across the day, from 22 yuan at breakfast to 54 yuan for late-night orders. The gap between the cheapest and most expensive meal is 32 yuan, more than double the breakfast average.

descriptions.ielts: Average order value was lowest for breakfast, at 22 yuan, and highest for late-night orders, at 54 yuan. Lunch and dinner recorded 38 and 46 yuan respectively, while afternoon tea stood at 31 yuan.
descriptions.business: Late-night orders carry the highest ticket at 54 yuan, but the real opportunity is dinner: it combines a 46-yuan average with much higher volume. Breakfast is a traffic play, not a margin play.
